findings.title: Imported empty IDs bypass the index scan and are silently regenerated
findings.suggested_fix: Validate every explicitly present id property by traversing the parsed definitions graph, not only Object.values(elementsById), before applying any fallback IDs. In particular, reject empty definitions, BPMNDiagram, and BPMNPlane IDs with their moddle paths instead of replacing them with Definitions_*, BPMNDiagram_*, or BPMNPlane_* defaults.

findings.title: Syntax validation declares empty xsd:ID attributes valid
findings.suggested_fix: Share a parsed-graph ID collector with import validation and emit BPMN_INVALID_ID for every explicitly authored non-NCName id, including empty IDs that moddle omits from elementsById. Add syntax/semantic/full cases for empty definitions, process/task, diagram, plane, shape, and edge IDs.

findings.title: Unicode alias restoration corrupts retained extension attributes
findings.suggested_fix: Do not skip $attrs during alias restoration, or preferably restrict XML rewriting to actual modeled ID/reference values. Verify that importing and reserializing a task with Unicode id and an unknown namespaced attribute holding the same value preserves that attribute rather than emitting __mcp_bpmn_unicode_id_*.

findings.title: Falsy authored IDs are generated instead of rejected
findings.suggested_fix: Generate only when an optional ID is strictly undefined. Replace the definition.id, payload.definitionId, and payload.reference.id truthiness defaults with explicit undefined checks so empty strings and other invalid supplied values reach assertBpmnId and reject atomically.

findings.title: Tool schemas trim authored IDs before NCName validation
findings.suggested_fix: Build bpmnId from an untransformed z.string() with the identifier length bounds and BPMN_ID_PATTERN, rather than from identifier().trim(). Add a request test proving a supplied definitionId such as " Task_1 " is rejected instead of authored as "Task_1".

residual_risks: The Unicode workaround rewrites XML with regular expressions and depends on bpmn-moddle's undocumented object storage; comments, CDATA, namespace-qualified references, or future moddle changes may expose additional aliasing mismatches.

Invalid IDs that moddle drops before building the object graph, such as leading-digit IDs, currently surface only as generic unparsable-content errors rather than stable path-aware BPMN_INVALID_ID diagnostics.
testing_gaps: No end-to-end table exercises empty IDs across engine creation, event definition/root IDs, imported semantic roots/elements, and all DI objects; the current predicate-only empty-string case does not cover the bypasses.
No retained-import round-trip test covers valid Unicode IDs duplicated in unknown namespaced $attrs.
No tool request test asserts that leading or trailing whitespace around an authored BPMN ID is rejected without normalization.
The scoped NCName tests pass (44/44), but they do not cover the reproduced empty-ID and extension-attribute cases.
